description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git's upload-pack ref-in-want feature. It contains test setup routines, utility functions, and test cases checking various scenarios related to fetching Git refs with specific options and configurations.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts actual refs from the output file by processing the 'out' stream with sed and test-tool pkt-line unpack.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Decodes the pack file 'out' to obtain commits, verifies pack integrity, and sorts commit hashes.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs a series of fetch reference and commit retrieval functions and compares the actual and expected refs and commits.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Outputs a command line with specified command type and object format if necessary.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs a fetch request by combining write_command output with refspecs and optional lines read from stdin.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates a server reference inconsistency by modifying the server's repository response during negotiation.
